The 2027 Chevy Trax's Facelift Comes with a $2000 Price Increase

The 10Best-winning Chevrolet Trax is about to get considerably more expensive. Chevy revealed pricing for the 2027 Trax on its consumer site, which shows a $2000 increase compared with last year’s car. Pricing for the 2027 Trax will start at $25,495 for the LT trim, which serves as the new entry point for the model now that the LS trim has been dropped.
